description: Minimize, maximize, restore, close, move, resize or focus a window of a desktop capsule, by id (from capsulate_windows) or a part of its title. move takes x, y (the new top-left corner); resize takes w, h (each at least 50). close asks the app to close, as the title bar's close button does, so it may first ask to save. Returns the window afterwards (none after close).

h.description: For resize: the new height (at least 50)

title.description: A part of the window's title

w.description: For resize: the new width (at least 50)

x.description: For move: the new left edge, in screen pixels

y.description: For move: the new top edge

name: capsulate_window
title: Manage a window
